proof.pattern: GTC STOP FAILED — no page sent|STOP ORDER FAILED

expected_rate: only when a protective stop order fails; zero lines on a day with no stop failure is normal
window_reason: Stop failures are rare; five sessions give a fair chance to see one page and its suppressed retries.
reversal: the same stop paging Slack or the phone more than once on one ET day, or a stop failure logged by a caller with no page that day
